request.style: English, Christian hip hop testimony, a male rapper telling the story in first person over a moody lo-fi piano beat, a melodic sung hook, sparse drums, reflective, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I was breathing out threats against the church of the Way
Letters from the high priest, chains for those who pray
On the road to Damascus, noon, the sun overhead
A light from heaven flashed and I fell like the dead
Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me
Who are you, Lord, tell me who I'm meant to see
I am Jesus, the one you have been fighting
Get up, go to the city, you'll be told what is right

[Chorus]
On the road to Damascus I was blind
But I saw the light for the first time
Scales fell from my eyes
Now I walk the road of life

[Verse]
Three days I sat in the dark, no food, no drink
Couldn't see a thing, all I could do was think
Then Ananias came and laid his hands on me
Brother Saul, the Lord has sent me so you can see
Something like scales fell off and I rose
Baptized in the name I had fought, now I know
The one I persecuted is the one who called my name
Chief of sinners, saved by grace, never the same

[Chorus]
On the road to Damascus I was blind
But I saw the light for the first time
Scales fell from my eyes
Now I walk the road of life
